# Elimu+

> Elimu+ is a practical entrepreneurship and employability training programme for women and youth in Likoni, Mombasa, Kenya. We train groups through churches, NGOs and colleges, then follow up at 30, 60 and 90 days until their businesses survive and grow. Training is in English and Kiswahili.

Start. Start small. Start to finish.

## About and contact
- [About Elimu+](https://elimuplus.com/about.html): who founded Elimu+, why, and the partners we work with
- Email: hello@elimuplus.com
- WhatsApp: +254 798 639 546
- Area served: Likoni and Mombasa County, Kenya

## The programme
- [Programme](https://elimuplus.com/programme.html): the 5-day Crush and the 12-day SEE Programme, the SEE Canvas and the SAME framework, with follow-up at 30, 60 and 90 days
- [Case studies](https://elimuplus.com/case-studies.html): three anonymised business stories from our first adult cohort
- [Break-even calculator](https://elimuplus.com/calculator.html): a free unit economics tool for small businesses (Uchumi wa Bidhaa)

## For organisations and trainers
- [Register your organisation](https://elimuplus.com/join.html): churches, NGOs and colleges that want a cohort
- [Partner with us](https://elimuplus.com/partner.html): 2026 rates and the partner brief
- [Become a trainer](https://elimuplus.com/trainer.html): facilitator certification
